verdict: Ads are not yet live; organic is holding, but paid launch is overdue.
narrative: No paid ads ran this period — $0 in spend across Google and Meta confirms neither channel has launched. Five pre-launch milestones that were due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete, and clearing those is the single priority right now. In the meantime, your Google Business Profile is the only active demand channel, delivering 83 actions in the last 28 days and growing. Your contact database holds 373 contacts, but only 1 new opportunity was created this period, so tightening the intake process is part of the work underway alongside the launch push. Once paid channels go live, you should begin seeing tracked leads and cost-per-lead data within the first reporting week.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days — calls, direction requests, and website clicks
week-over-week rise in Google Business Profile activity, showing steady local search visibility
paid ad spend this period — no Google or Meta campaigns have gone live yet

watch_item.issue: Five launch milestones are now 25–26 days past their due dates, leaving paid ads unlaunched and every revenue path dependent on organic alone.
watch_item.fix: The pre-launch stack test, LSA verification, site and landing pages, and both ad launches are being resolved as the immediate priority so campaigns can go live this week.
